headline: Talent Acquisition Specialist
summary: Talent acquisition specialist with four years hiring for BPO and shared-services companies in Davao. I plan headcount with operations managers, run sourcing and interviews end to end, and fill 30 to 50 roles a month in peak season. I also handle offers, onboarding handover and HR processes around new hires.
skills: Sourcing: job boards, referrals, school partnerships

experience.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
bullets: Hire for customer service, finance and IT support accounts, averaging 38 hires a month.
Plan monthly hiring needs with operations managers from attrition and new-account forecasts.
Set up partnerships with four colleges, now the source of a quarter of new hires.
Cut time-to-hire from 24 to 16 days by batching assessments and final interviews.
Prepare and explain job offers and hand new hires over to onboarding.

experience.title: Recruitment Associate
bullets: Screened applicants for client companies and coordinated interview days.
Kept the applicant database and weekly recruitment reports up to date.
